defs.def: bad or dangerous 不好的；严重的；有危险的

ex.s: Leigh Tindale’s dog Charlie had a serious heart condition.
ex.t: Leigh Tindale的狗Charlie有严重的心脏问题。

ex.s: Russia’s public health care service has been in serious need of modernization.
ex.t: 俄罗斯的公共卫生保健服务一直迫切需要现代化。

ex.s: The inability to engage with longer-term causes and consequences leads to some of the world’s most serious problems: climate change, biodiversity collapse, and more.
ex.t: 无法关注长期的原因和后果导致了一些世界上最严重的问题：气候变化、生物多样性丧失等等。

ex.s: So, don’t stop speaking when you make a mistake unless it’s a truly serious one.

ex.t: 海狸鼠严重破坏生态系统。

ex.s: After a serious flu outbreak wipes out 99.4% of the world's population, a battle unfolds between good and evil among those let.
ex.t: 一场严重的流感消灭了全球99.4%的人口后，在幸存者中展开了一场善与恶的战斗。

ex.t: 对帝王蝶惊人能力之谜的解答，出现在它陷入严重困境之时。

ex.t: 根据这一理论，人们以一种适合社交媒体的心态对待电子文本——往往不那么严肃，投入的脑力也比读纸质文本时少。

ex.t: "如果我把黏土带到这里，每天下午工作三小时，我可以在你在办公桌前工作时完成大部分项目。"

ex.t: 寓言可以在世界各地找到，他们的吸引力之一是他们如何为更严肃的信息增添幽默感。

ex.s: Above all, I hoped he wouldn't assign me to work with the fiercely competitive, extremely serious fellow who always wore dark clothes and apparently had a personality to match.
ex.t: 最重要的是，我希望他不会把我分配给那个竞争心极强、极其严肃、总是穿深色衣服、而且显然性格也与之相称的家伙。

defs.def: thinking about things in a careful and sensible way; not silly 严肃的；稳重的
sincere about sth; not joking or meant as a joke 当真的；认真的

ex.s: You can’t be serious
ex.t: 你在开玩笑吧

ex.s: Father: (raising his voice in surprise) You can't be serious!
ex.t: 父亲: (提高他的声音惊奇) 你不能是认真的!

ex.s: I don't think it should be… Besides, … Are you serious?!
